declarations.name: AuiVirtualList

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: The items (up to 1,000,000; the total height must stay under the browser limit, about 17.9 million px in Firefox); only the visible ones are rendered.

inputs.name: renderItem
inputs.description: Content of one item; called whenever the item is rendered.

inputs.name: itemKey
inputs.description: Stable key per item, used by value. Default: the index.

inputs.name: itemText
inputs.description: Type-ahead text. Default: strings, numbers, or the item's label property.

inputs.name: itemHeight
inputs.description: Item height in pixels (the estimate with variableHeight). Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

inputs.name: variableHeight
inputs.description: Measure every rendered item instead of a fixed height.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Block size of the scroll area as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

inputs.name: selection
inputs.description: none renders a plain list; single and multiple render a listbox.

inputs.name: selectionFollowsFocus
inputs.description: Single selection: moving focus with the keyboard also selects.

inputs.name: isDisabled
inputs.description: Items that cannot be selected or focused.

inputs.name: empty
inputs.description: Shown instead of the list when there are no items (for example an Empty State host).

inputs.name: loadMore
inputs.description: Infinite scroll: called near the end; resolve after appending items with update({ items }).

inputs.name: hasMore
inputs.description: More items can be loaded (with loadMore).

inputs.name: loadMoreThreshold
inputs.description: Items from the end at which loading starts.

inputs.name: overscan
inputs.description: Items rendered beyond each edge of the visible area (0 to 100).

inputs.name: density
inputs.description: Default item height when itemHeight is not set.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the selection: { value, index }.

outputs.name: rangeChange
outputs.description: The visible range changed: { start, end, renderedStart, renderedEnd } (for lazy loading).

methods.name: scrollToIndex
methods.signature: scrollToIndex(index: number, align?: VirtualListAlign | undefined): void
methods.description: Scroll so the item is visible (auto: only as far as needed).

methods.name: focusItem
methods.description: Focus an item of a listbox, scrolling it into view.

methods.name: getItemElement
methods.description: The rendered element of an item, or null.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Render the visible items again after item objects changed in place.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Listbox (single and multiple selection, roving focus, type-ahead) when selectable; a plain list (role=list) otherwise. Items carry aria-posinset and aria-setsize because only part of the list is rendered.

limitations: The total height (items x item height) must stay under the browser's maximum element height, about 17.9 million px in Firefox.
Only rendered items exist in the DOM, so the browser's find-in-page and printing see only those.
Variable heights are estimated until an item has been rendered once, so the scrollbar can adjust while scrolling.
